name: Mahindra EPC Irrigation Ltd
title: Mahindra EPC Irrigation Ltd - 523754 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management reports record FY26 revenue of INR315.8 crores (+14.8%) and PBT of INR16.99 crores, but Q4 PBT fell to INR6.4 crores on a March PE pipe price spike and receivables are high at INR217 crores.

utilisation.quote: your company registered a growth of 14.8% with INR315.8 crores revenue versus FY25 revenue of 275.1 crores

capex.quote: So we do have capex plans. We have capex plans every year and then obviously we manage our capex planning basis the requirements of the business

triggers.label: Raw material prices spike in March
triggers.quote: in February 2026, on average, the PE pipe grades saw a 58%, 59% price increase

triggers.label: Project order book INR54 crores visible
triggers.quote: There is definitely visibility for the INR55 crores, it's actually INR54 crores.

triggers.label: Receivables INR217 crores, 80-90% subsidy
triggers.quote: about 80% to 90% of it comes from the subsidy business

triggers.label: Price hike pending government decision
triggers.quote: Difficult to call, a point in time when the discussions will conclude

guidance.value: No numeric outlook; management does not give outlooks
guidance.quote: we don't tend to give outlooks

red_flags.label: Negative operating FCF over 3-5 years
red_flags.quote: Last four years is total zero, and even five years if I ever were to take it's negative INR22 crores?

red_flags.label: Q4 PBT down on raw material spike
red_flags.quote: the company registered a INR6.4 crores PBT versus INR9.4 crores last Q4

evasions.topic: Price increase timing and EBITDA margin target
evasions.quote: we don't tend to give outlooks
Difficult to call, a point in time when the discussions will conclude
